review.notes: Reconciliation fix: one package containing both the main ~adv repairs (codex-lf8pwI) and the closed branch claude-bibFuI-pkg-escmc2 (PR #11056). All four findings of REV-PKG-EulerSystemsCyclotomicMainConjecture stay resolved, now with both routes where they are complementary. Section 3.3: the branch's exact statements (a)-(d) (Sinnott's circular-unit components, semilocal and p-ramified control, equal mu/lambda totals) are the primary proof, sharpened to an exact psi(p)=1 formula (U^psi_inf = T Y^psi_inf) and corrected (semilocal psi-parts can have mu_p-torsion, so O'-rank rather than freeness; the branch's growing-error example had infinite length and was replaced). Main's global-unit descent (Belliard), norm-limit adapter and bounded Sinnott correction are kept as statement (e) with their proof as a second route. Section 4.7: the branch's smoothed-unit proof in Greither's normalisation is step 7, with its integrality argument corrected (poles at X=1-zeta_p^j as well as X=0); main's ColemanPowerSeries L4 transport and smoothed Stickelberger targets are kept as steps 8-12. Section 4.18: main's three targets kept; the branch's direct Baker-Brumer argument added as step 8. Section 4.21: main's Solomon/Mazur-Wiles lattice route kept as the proof; the branch's chi(p)!=1 argument added for every odd p, and its split-case adaptation of Greither's dyadic proof added only for trivial p-Sylow, because Greither's chi-to-chi0 replacement (pp.486-487) uses the dyadic property (g). Sections 3.4, 5.1 and the IntegralIwasawaTheory L0, Dirichlet L2-L3, Baker-Brumer and class-field-theory contracts take the branch's versions, verified against Sinnott Theorem 4.1, Proposition 5.1 and the p.182 tower theorem; local reciprocity is cited from Tau Ceti ClassFieldTheory Layers 6-7. All six admitted test theorems of Suggested.lean are now proved and two computed Section 4.7 witnesses were added. lean-check: exit 0, only 15 declaration-uses-sorry warnings, no errors. check_sorry_data, git diff --check, intake check-files, mech_check (unchanged apart from counts) and the anchor/backward-link check pass; depcheck reports only NOT IN ORDER, identical to main. The packet is unchanged; packet follow-ups are listed in the handoff.
